items.quote: said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse
items.contrast: Micah’s mother uttered the curse; Micah heard it rather than uttering it.
items.reason: A reader could confuse the speaker with the person who cursed, but Micah is addressing his mother as “you” and says that he heard “you utter a curse,” uniquely identifying his mother.
